query:
SELECT o.orderNumber, o.customerName, op.productName, op.color, op.quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN orderProducts op ON o.id = op.orderId
WHERE o.orderNumber IN ('26EGB0190')
AND (op.productName LIKE '%UP920%' OR op.productName LIKE '%UP911%');
